text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock B and Stock D after gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on prospects and portfolio needs, not just the satisfaction of locking in gains.","My account value rose overall despite some monthly declines; I should avoid letting losses loom larger than gains and stick with a long-term, considered plan.","I made no trades for several periods, which helped me avoid unnecessary activity; I should continue reviewing diversification and risk without trading merely to feel in control."]}
